name: platform-directory-section
purpose: A directory of Azion's products under a section title: one column per product group (Build, Store, Secure, Observe), each row an icon, a product name and one line about it, linking to that product. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'platform-directory-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — so its whole API is the props below, and it composes `module`, `module-header`, `registration-frame` and `link-directory` rather than owning any anatomy of its own.
useWhen: Use PlatformDirectorySection for the Azion products directory band.
On Home, right under the hero, to show every product the platform offers at a glance.
On a solution, product or pricing page that repeats the full product map.
avoidWhen: For a handful of icon-led use cases → use `customer-use-cases-section`.
For a site-wide navigation menu → use `navigation-menu`.
Inside another band's cell → compose `link-directory` directly.
related: `link-directory` — the named navigation landmark whose columns and rows this band fills.
bestPractices: Keep to four groups or fewer; the directory fans out to one column per group at the large breakpoint, up to four, so one, two or three groups never leave an empty cell.
Give each item an `href`; an item without a title or a link is skipped, and a group left with no items is skipped too.
Set `ariaLabel` so the directory's navigation landmark is told apart from the site navigation; left empty, the landmark takes the `title`.
Use `eyebrow` for the short label above the headline (the page's name for the product map) and `description` for one sentence under it.
Give the band an `anchor` when a page links to it with a `#hash`.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Short label above the headline; shown only with a title.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline over the directory, rendered by the section title as its `h2`; the band renders no header, eyebrow or description when empty.

props.name: description
props.doc: One sentence under the headline; shown only with a title.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the directory's navigation landmark; empty uses the title.

props.name: groups
props.doc: The columns, in order; each is `{ title, items }` where every item is `{ icon, title, description, href }`. Items without a title or an `href` are skipped, and so are groups left empty.
